definition_policy: Platform-owned definitions, not certification of compliance with a reporting standard. Aliases are retrieval clues, not permission to merge different scopes or concepts. Rules are declarative, not an implemented normalisation/scoring engine. Missing remains null; targets never equal performance.

reference_sources.title: GHG Protocol Scope 2 Guidance
reference_sources.use: Separate location- and market-based methods; retain accounting-method version.

reference_sources.title: GRI Water and Effluents (303)
reference_sources.use: Keep withdrawal, consumption and discharge distinct; preserve water context.

reference_sources.title: SBTi Target Dashboard
reference_sources.use: Distinguish commitments, validated targets and removed commitments; preserve raw labels and as-of dates.

reference_sources.title: IFRS S2 Climate-related Disclosures
reference_sources.use: Disclosure/reference is not an independent compliance assessment.

metrics.name: Base-year emissions
metrics.description: Historical emissions baseline for the identified metric, target and inventory boundary.

normalisation_rule.description: Multiply only explicit CO2-equivalent mass units by exact decimal factors. Never convert CO2-only, carbon mass, offsets or avoided emissions into gross GHG emissions.

metrics.comparability_warning: A baseline is historical context, not current achieved performance. Restated and original baselines must not be mixed; the baseline year is not the current reporting year.

rules: Preserve raw value, raw unit, source page/excerpt and validation state separately from normalised values.
A missing disclosure or extraction failure is null, never zero or false.
Unknown required context prevents comparison; schema validation alone is not factual validation.
Gross inventory values exclude offsets, avoided emissions and separately reported removals.

metrics.name: Emissions intensity
metrics.description: Reported GHG emissions per explicitly defined activity, output, employee or monetary denominator.

normalisation_rule.description: Normalise the numerator to tCO2e only after its scope and GWP basis are known. Preserve denominator identity, unit and scale; no currency FX, revenue inflation adjustment or denominator substitution is implicit.

metrics.comparability_warning: Revenue, production, electricity and headcount intensities cannot be pooled. Currency, price year, denominator scaling, sector and included emissions must match.

rules: Preserve raw value, raw unit, source page/excerpt and validation state separately from normalised values.
A missing disclosure or extraction failure is null, never zero or false.
Unknown required context prevents comparison; schema validation alone is not factual validation.
Denominator value must be greater than zero.
Unit entries are templates, not interchangeable units; unresolved denominator or scope means not_comparable.

metrics.name: Combined Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions
metrics.description: Reported sum of gross Scope 1 plus exactly one explicitly identified Scope 2 method.

normalisation_rule.description: Multiply only explicit CO2-equivalent mass units by exact decimal factors. Never convert CO2-only, carbon mass, offsets or avoided emissions into gross GHG emissions.

metrics.comparability_warning: Do not sum location- and market-based Scope 2. A combined number without its Scope 2 method is not comparable; no automatic total is derived.

rules: Preserve raw value, raw unit, source page/excerpt and validation state separately from normalised values.
A missing disclosure or extraction failure is null, never zero or false.
Unknown required context prevents comparison; schema validation alone is not factual validation.
Gross inventory values exclude offsets, avoided emissions and separately reported removals.

metrics.name: Scope 1 emissions
metrics.description: Direct gross GHG emissions from sources owned or controlled under the stated consolidation basis.

normalisation_rule.description: Multiply only explicit CO2-equivalent mass units by exact decimal factors. Never convert CO2-only, carbon mass, offsets or avoided emissions into gross GHG emissions.

metrics.comparability_warning: Company size, acquisitions, control basis, gas coverage and GWP versions affect totals; gross direct emissions are not offset-adjusted net emissions.

rules: Preserve raw value, raw unit, source page/excerpt and validation state separately from normalised values.
A missing disclosure or extraction failure is null, never zero or false.

metrics.name: Scope 2 emissions — location-based
metrics.description: Gross indirect energy emissions using the stated location-based method.

normalisation_rule.description: Multiply only explicit CO2-equivalent mass units by exact decimal factors. Never convert CO2-only, carbon mass, offsets or avoided emissions into gross GHG emissions.

metrics.comparability_warning: Never pool with market-based Scope 2 or add both methods together. Grid geography and included purchased energy types differ.

rules: Preserve raw value, raw unit, source page/excerpt and validation state separately from normalised values.
A missing disclosure or extraction failure is null, never zero or false.

scope2_method must equal location_based.

normalisation_rule.description: Multiply only explicit CO2-equivalent mass units by exact decimal factors. Never convert CO2-only, carbon mass, offsets or avoided emissions into gross GHG emissions.

metrics.comparability_warning: Never pool with location-based Scope 2 or treat contractual reductions as identical to physical grid reductions. Instrument quality and residual mixes matter.

normalisation_rule.description: Multiply only explicit CO2-equivalent mass units by exact decimal factors. Never convert CO2-only, carbon mass, offsets or avoided emissions into gross GHG emissions.

metrics.comparability_warning: Different category coverage, estimation methods and financed-emissions boundaries make totals non-comparable; do not imply coverage of all 15 categories.

metrics.name: Total GHG emissions as reported

normalisation_rule.description: Multiply only explicit CO2-equivalent mass units by exact decimal factors. Never convert CO2-only, carbon mass, offsets or avoided emissions into gross GHG emissions.

metrics.comparability_warning: The word total is not a consistent boundary. May omit Scope 3 or include netting; never equate this generic total with a defined Scope 1+2+3 inventory.

metrics.name: Year-on-year emissions change
metrics.description: Percentage change in the same emissions measure relative to a comparable immediately preceding annual period.

normalisation_rule.description: Canonical sign is (current - prior) / prior * 100. Use reported change only with stated sign convention; reverse a stated reduction percentage explicitly. Do not treat percentage points as percent change or derive from incompatible periods.

metrics.comparability_warning: Prior emissions must be positive. Restatements, boundary changes, acquisitions, period length and absolute-versus-intensity definitions can invalidate the trend.

rules: Preserve raw value, raw unit, source page/excerpt and validation state separately from normalised values.
A missing disclosure or extraction failure is null, never zero or false.
Unknown required context prevents comparison; schema validation alone is not factual validation.
Prior year must immediately precede the current reporting year and prior value must be greater than zero.
Negative means decrease; positive means increase. An increase above 100 percent is allowed.
The -100 percent floor applies only to comparable nonnegative gross inventories.

metrics.name: Electricity consumption
metrics.description: Electricity consumed by the stated operations, with purchased and self-generated coverage identified.

normalisation_rule.description: Convert explicit energy quantities to GJ using exact decimal factors. Power units (kW/MW), primary-versus-final energy, heating-value bases and sold-versus-consumed energy are not interchangeable.

metrics.comparability_warning: Consumed electricity differs from purchased, generated or exported electricity. Do not treat this subset as total energy.

rules: Preserve raw value, raw unit, source page/excerpt and validation state separately from normalised values.
A missing disclosure or extraction failure is null, never zero or false.

metrics.name: Renewable electricity percentage
metrics.description: Renewable electricity consumed divided by total electricity consumed for the same boundary.

normalisation_rule.description: Convert a share explicitly labelled percent or fraction to percent. A decimal such as 0.5 is not assumed to be a fraction. Percentage-point changes are not percentage levels.

metrics.comparability_warning: Electricity is only a subset of energy. Physical supply, certificates and contractual procurement methods require separate or harmonised comparison groups.

rules: Preserve raw value, raw unit, source page/excerpt and validation state separately from normalised values.
A missing disclosure or extraction failure is null, never zero or false.

metrics.name: Renewable energy percentage

normalisation_rule.description: Convert a share explicitly labelled percent or fraction to percent. A decimal such as 0.5 is not assumed to be a fraction. Percentage-point changes are not percentage levels.

metrics.comparability_warning: Do not substitute renewable electricity share. Fuel sustainability definitions, heating values and energy carrier coverage affect comparability.

metrics.comparability_warning: Do not combine primary/final energy, heating-value conventions or energy sold with energy consumed. Absolute totals are size-dependent.

metrics.name: Carbon-neutral target year

normalisation_rule.description: Retain an explicitly stated four-digit target calendar year. No inferred year from phrases such as soon, future or carbon neutral; retain claim wording separately.

metrics.comparability_warning: Net zero and carbon neutrality are not interchangeable. Target scope, gases, residual emissions, offsets/removals and validation differ; earlier does not automatically rank better.

rules: Preserve raw value, raw unit, source page/excerpt and validation state separately from normalised values.

metrics.name: Interim emissions target
metrics.description: A time-bound interim GHG target with baseline, amount, metric basis and scope retained together.

normalisation_rule.description: Retain a structured target: absolute or intensity basis, stated amount/unit, target and baseline years, scope and status. Numeric/unit normalisation is deferred until all target dimensions are explicit; no single scalar unit exists.

metrics.comparability_warning: A 50 percent intensity target and a 50 percent absolute reduction target are not equivalent. Targets are commitments, not achieved reductions.

amount.description: Exact raw decimal string, not a float.

rules: Preserve raw value, raw unit, source page/excerpt and validation state separately from normalised values.
A missing disclosure or extraction failure is null, never zero or false.
Unknown required context prevents comparison; schema validation alone is not factual validation.
Baseline year must not exceed target year when present.
Percent reductions must be between 0 and 100; an absolute target amount must be nonnegative.
Intensity targets additionally require denominator identity, unit and scale.
Store under targets; no observation or ranked scalar is created.

metrics.name: Net-zero target year
metrics.description: Target year for an explicitly defined net-zero commitment; not an achieved result.

normalisation_rule.description: Retain an explicitly stated four-digit target calendar year. No inferred year from phrases such as soon, future or carbon neutral; retain claim wording separately.

metrics.comparability_warning: Net zero and carbon neutrality are not interchangeable. Target scope, gases, residual emissions, offsets/removals and validation differ; earlier does not automatically rank better.

metrics.name: SBTi status
metrics.description: Reported science-based-target commitment or validation status at a specific date, including near-term/net-zero applicability.

normalisation_rule.description: Map only explicit reported labels to the internal non-ordinal status vocabulary. Preserve the original status label, source/date and whether the claim was checked against SBTi. Unrecognised labels remain other_reported_status with raw text.

metrics.comparability_warning: Commitment is not validation, and target validation is not achieved performance. SBTi labels and standard versions evolve; retain as-of date, target type and raw label.

rules: Preserve raw value, raw unit, source page/excerpt and validation state separately from normalised values.
A missing disclosure or extraction failure is null, never zero or false.
Unknown required context prevents comparison; schema validation alone is not factual validation.
This internal vocabulary is not an ordinal score or a claim to reproduce every official SBTi status.
Company-reported validation is not independently verified unless the status source documents that check.

metrics.name: Water consumption
metrics.description: Water consumed under the report's stated definition, including the treatment of storage changes.

normalisation_rule.description: Convert explicit water volume to cubic metres. An unspecified gallon is ambiguous; no density-based mass conversion, netting, or withdrawal/consumption/discharge substitution.

metrics.comparability_warning: Consumption is not gross withdrawal. Do not automatically compute withdrawal minus discharge when periods, storage or boundaries differ.

rules: Preserve raw value, raw unit, source page/excerpt and validation state separately from normalised values.
A missing disclosure or extraction failure is null, never zero or false.

metrics.name: Water discharge

normalisation_rule.description: Convert explicit water volume to cubic metres. An unspecified gallon is ambiguous; no density-based mass conversion, netting, or withdrawal/consumption/discharge substitution.

metrics.comparability_warning: Discharge volume says nothing alone about water quality or receiving-basin impact. Withdrawal, consumption and discharge cannot be pooled.

rules: Preserve raw value, raw unit, source page/excerpt and validation state separately from normalised values.
A missing disclosure or extraction failure is null, never zero or false.
Unknown required context prevents comparison; schema validation alone is not factual validation.

metrics.name: Water withdrawal

normalisation_rule.description: Convert explicit water volume to cubic metres. An unspecified gallon is ambiguous; no density-based mass conversion, netting, or withdrawal/consumption/discharge substitution.

metrics.comparability_warning: Withdrawal is not consumption or discharge. Compare sources, freshwater coverage and water-stressed basin exposure; company-wide volume alone is not water impact.

rules: Preserve raw value, raw unit, source page/excerpt and validation state separately from normalised values.
A missing disclosure or extraction failure is null, never zero or false.
Unknown required context prevents comparison; schema validation alone is not factual validation.

metrics.comparability_warning: Hazardous definitions vary by jurisdiction. Compare the same classification and boundary; do not assume every report uses the same hazard criteria.

rules: Preserve raw value, raw unit, source page/excerpt and validation state separately from normalised values.
A missing disclosure or extraction failure is null, never zero or false.
Unknown required context prevents comparison; schema validation alone is not factual validation.

metrics.name: Waste recycled or diverted percentage

normalisation_rule.description: Convert a share explicitly labelled percent or fraction to percent. A decimal such as 0.5 is not assumed to be a fraction. Percentage-point changes are not percentage levels.

metrics.comparability_warning: Recycling, diversion from disposal and diversion from landfill are not synonyms. Incineration with energy recovery may count in diversion but not recycling; compare identical route definitions only.

rules: Preserve raw value, raw unit, source page/excerpt and validation state separately from normalised values.

metrics.name: Total waste generated

metrics.comparability_warning: Generation, disposal and waste managed for customers are different quantities. Hazardous classifications and construction/operational coverage differ.

rules: Preserve raw value, raw unit, source page/excerpt and validation state separately from normalised values.

metrics.comparability_warning: Assurance of selected indicators is not assurance of the whole report. Scope, level, provider independence and qualifications matter; no simple ordinal ranking is assigned.

rules: Preserve raw value, raw unit, source page/excerpt and validation state separately from normalised values.
A missing disclosure or extraction failure is null, never zero or false.
Unknown required context prevents comparison; schema validation alone is not factual validation.
Unknown or unstated level cannot be mapped to reasonable or limited.

normalisation_rule.description: Accept explicit true/false assertions only. Do not infer false from silence, missing pages, absence of keywords or missing model output.

metrics.comparability_warning: Committee existence alone does not prove effective oversight or sustainability outcomes; remit, reporting cadence and authority differ.

rules: Preserve raw value, raw unit, source page/excerpt and validation state separately from normalised values.

rules: Preserve raw value, raw unit, source page/excerpt and validation state separately from normalised values.

normalisation_rule.description: Convert explicitly stated headcount to persons. FTE and contractor counts are not headcount units; no implicit conversion or rounding to manufacture an integer.

metrics.comparability_warning: Year-end headcount, average headcount, FTE and workers including contractors differ. More employees is not inherently better sustainability performance.

rules: Preserve raw value, raw unit, source page/excerpt and validation state separately from normalised values.

metrics.comparability_warning: Recordable, lost-time, high-consequence and fatal-injury measures are different metrics. Jurisdiction, reporting incentives and contractor coverage affect comparisons.

Aliases are retrieval clues only: recordable and lost-time rates remain separate comparison groups.

metrics.comparability_warning: Disclosure availability is not environmental or social performance. A failed parser, missing report or absence in a retrieved chunk cannot establish false.

rules: Preserve raw value, raw unit, source page/excerpt and validation state separately from normalised values.
A missing disclosure or extraction failure is null, never zero or false.
Unknown required context prevents comparison; schema validation alone is not factual validation.
An explicit reported zero counts as available; a target-only figure does not.
False requires a completed, documented review of the defined source set; otherwise retain null and the appropriate review state.
Do not encode boolean disclosure indicators as 0/1 performance scores.
